# /crav1-explain-tech

lane: cross-cutting | group: Keep the picture current | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.192.0 | prompts: 3
purpose: Explain one technology (what it is, how it works, where the specs use it, why, the tradeoff, one alternative).
use_when: You want one technology explained in the context of your specs
reads: Reads `docs/specs/`, `docs/architecture/spec.md` and its ADRs, `docs/architecture/designs/`, and `docs/system/` to find where the technology appears.
writes: Writes the answer in the chat. On `save` or a yes on the save card, appends a dated Technology notes entry to `docs/specs/<slug>/notes.md` or `docs/architecture/notes.md`, creating the file when it is missing.
leaves alone: Leaves specs, plans, tasks, design topics and ADRs alone. Writes nothing without save.
limits: never invents a spec link; a technology the specs do not mention is said plainly. A save link that is not in the specs is refused.
flow:
- **`/crav1-explain-tech`** explains one technology, such as Private Link or Service Bus, tied to where the specs use it.
- `explain_tech.py find` lists every mention in specs, plans, tasks, notes, the architecture spec, ADRs, design topics and system notes, with links to the exact file and section, plus owners and the spec to save to.
- The short answer (150 to 250 words) has a fixed shape: what it is, how it works, where it shows up, why it is used, main tradeoff, one alternative, then Run next.
- `deeper` gives 300 to 900 words and adds how it fits with the rest of the spec.
- A technology the specs never mention is said plainly and explained in general terms, with no spec link and research named in Run next.
- Missing facts name who has them (ADR deciders, `Owner:` lines, the spec's `## Approval needed`).
- `check` tests the shape, the word count and every link; kit-lint runs it on the samples.
- `save` (the word, or yes on the card) appends `### <technology> (YYYY-MM-DD)` with the short explanation and its links under `## Technology notes` in the spec's `notes.md` (created when missing; `docs/architecture/notes.md` for the architecture spec).

## Choice words
- question: Depth and save
  - `deeper`: a longer answer with how it fits the rest of the spec
  - `save`: append a dated note to the spec's notes file
called_by: Called by the user.
runs by itself: Calls no skill. Runs `scripts/explain_tech.py`.
you run next: nothing in particular
first: `/crav1-explain-tech Service Bus`
walkthrough: from-explain-tech.md
human: https://github.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/blob/v1.209.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-explain-tech.md
